services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Escape to a one-of-a-kind waterfront retreat, where modern comfort meets coastal charm. This brand-new two-bedroom houseboat offers an unparalleled stay on the Rehoboth Bay, surrounded by breathtaking views and the serenity of life on the water. Thoughtfully designed with stylish furnishings, a fully stocked kitchen, and inviting living spaces, it provides the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Nestled in the heart of Rehoboth Bay Marina, just moments from the beach and the vibrant energy of Dewey Beach, this unique getaway promises an unforgettable experience. blurb: Rehoboth Bay Marina is a full-service marina located in the Rehoboth-Dewey Beach area. They offer boat and jet ski slips, transient docking, boat rentals, detailing services, and a unique two-bedroom houseboat rental. Amenities include a ship store, fuel dock, bathrooms, laundry, parking, Wi-Fi, and community activities.
